visual_text: Write each fall down on the day
In a US study, 13 to 32 in 100 people with a confirmed fall did not recall falling in the months they were asked about.
Could you get up? How long on the floor?
Take this to every appointment. An hour or more on the floor is a sign of high risk: tell the doctor.
Cummings et al., J Am Geriatr Soc 1988; World Falls Guidelines 2022
alt_text: Printable falls note: write each fall down on the day. In a US study, 13 to 32 in 100 people with a confirmed fall did not recall falling in the months they were asked about. Blank table, five columns: date and time; where; what you were doing; how you felt just before; could you get up, how long on the floor. Take it to every appointment; an hour or more on the floor is a sign of high risk.
